mentions.name: Audio FPAA ASIC
mentions.description: An audio field-programmable analog array (FPAA) ASIC being designed for the Wafer Space run 3 chip fabrication shuttle, with a fast-approaching deadline and many design blocks still only partially validated. Future revisions may save die area by using a pad ring that needs only two edges.
